note: Knowledge checks are a reading check only. A pass on them is not verified practical competence.

knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The uncertainty is recorded and classification is referred. Appearance is not used to classify.
The NSW release lists sewage containing harmful bacteria among flood clean-up hazards.

practicalCriteria: The learner records contamination as uncertain until a competent person classifies it.
The learner does not classify water from appearance or odour.
Learner completes the procedure record for the mock case and names the stop-work trigger before any practical step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed mock decision record for the lesson case
Assessor observation of the simulated scenario, with no real site work or hazardous material
stopWorkCriteria: Contamination is unknown or has not been classified.
A sewage indicator is present and no referral is recorded.
